senses.definition: (transitive) To shield (someone or something) from light.
examples: The old oak tree shaded the lawn in the heat of the day.

senses.definition: (intransitive, rare) To shield oneself from light.
examples: We shaded under a huge oak tree.

senses.definition: (transitive) To alter slightly.
examples: You'll need to shade your shot slightly to the left.

senses.definition: (intransitive) To vary or approach something slightly, particularly in color.
